description: Force indexing (paid backlink and Google indexer): submit the exact saved quote once. Copy quoteId AND idempotencyKey from the quote response; reuse that exact pair for every retry, never invent a new submit key. Requires the account owner's stored approval from authenticated CrakSEO web confirmation; tool arguments cannot approve spending. Otherwise returns needs_confirmation and an owned confirmation URL. Reserves URL credits; charges 1 credit per URL the indexing service accepts. No guarantee that Google indexes the page. Unknown outcomes must not be blindly retried.
name: submit_force_indexing
title: Force indexing: submit approved quote
